verdict.rationale: Docs confirm dynamic templates with multiple versions and a documented flow for sending emails with dynamic templates (sendgrid-docs-10, sendgrid-docs-27), and the Mail Send API is the mechanism for triggering sends (sendgrid-docs-2, sendgrid-docs-15). However, the evidence pack never shows explicit API endpoints for creating/updating/versioning templates programmatically nor an explicit example of specifying template_id with a variable payload in a send call. Missing for 10: explicit Template API (create/version/update) endpoint docs, explicit code sample sending by template_id with dynamic_template_data variables, independent confirmation of template API usage.
